title: Road Hazard Protection Cancellation Terms Schedule
content:
Road Hazard Protection certificates carry the cancellation terms below. A cancellation completed within the full-refund window on a certificate with no claim at all is refunded in full; a later cancellation is refunded pro rata by the whole months left in the term, with the plan's administration fee withheld and the plan benefits already paid deducted.

The six Road Hazard Protection plans, from rank 1 to rank 6, are the Crestline Road Hazard 12-Month Protection, the Crestline Road Hazard 24-Month Protection, the Crestline Road Hazard 36-Month Protection, the Crestline Road Hazard Plus 36-Month Protection, the Crestline Road Hazard Life-of-Tread Protection and the Crestline Road Hazard Commercial LT Protection; the columns below use the short names 12-Month, 24-Month, 36-Month, Plus 36, Life-of-Tread and Commercial LT.

| | 12-Month | 24-Month | 36-Month | Plus 36 | Life-of-Tread | Commercial LT |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Full-refund window, calendar days after the purchase date | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| Administration fee withheld from a pro-rata refund | 15.00 USD | 20.00 USD | 25.00 USD | 25.00 USD | 25.00 USD | 25.00 USD |
| Refund after the full-refund window | pro rata by unexpired months | pro rata by unexpired months | pro rata by unexpired months | pro rata by unexpired months | pro rata by unexpired months | pro rata by unexpired months |
| Benefits already paid deducted from a pro-rata refund | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |

**Reading the schedule.** The administration fee is a flat amount per certificate, not per tire. The benefits deducted are the amounts the plan has paid under the certificate, so a certificate that has paid more than its unexpired share less the fee refunds nothing.

**Hypothetical comparison.** For two hypothetical certificates whose unexpired share comes to 60.00 and that have paid no benefits, the 12-Month certificate refunds 45.00 and the 24-Month certificate refunds 40.00.
